description: A small round zen garden tray with white sand sits on a sheet of paper, with a stone and a tiny figurine inside and a yellow mini rake beside it. The left hand stays resting near the tray, while the right hand picks up the yellow rake and drags its teeth through the sand in short strokes across the right side toward the center, smoothing and leaving neat grooves, then lifts the rake and sets it back down to the right.
